theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Energy (+0.02%) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.00%) led the market today, while Materials (-0.38%) and Industrials (-0.31%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.15%, defensives -0.12%, and value/cyclicals -0.16% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.43%, Dow +0.98%, Nasdaq +0.43% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.85%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 4.89% to 15.87, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.42% to $4,718.00, crude oil was little changed at $85.43, and bitcoin gained 1.11% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
